proposedFix: Not a V21 defect. To make B-06 testable, org config work (outside validation scope) is required: (a) activate at least one Evergreen ProductSellingModel (e.g. Evergreen-Monthly 0jPWC00000006C92AI), (b) create a ProductSellingModelOption linking a SaaS product to it, (c) create an active Evergreen PricebookEntry in the Fortra Price Book with a non-zero list price, (d) order+activate to create an Evergreen Asset, (e) build a Renewal Quote (QuoteAction.Type='Renew') with that Evergreen line carrying a positive source net, then force-reprice through V21 and assert PricingTermCount=1 / no end-date derivation / prior-net preserved. The V21 Evergreen branch metadata itself (Assignment72, ListContainer70, renewal carry-forward) requires no change.
notes: This verdict is unchanged across run1 (2026-06-29) and run3 (2026-06-30).
